verdict.rationale: Rootly ships a built-in assistant, Rootly AI. In Slack, users can delegate concrete actions to it, such as updating severity, paging teams and converting an incident to private. Rootly AI SRE investigates alerts and incidents on its own and returns a diagnosis, and AI Instructions steer how Rootly Agents carry out tasks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated actions work reliably, and in-app web delegation, since the web chat is documented as read-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Page the security team, and convert this to a private incident.
mention @Rootly in the channel or thread and ask "catch me up" or "page the database on-call team". Rootly AI always replies in-thread.
Rootly AI SRE investigates active alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and gives responders a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps.
AI Instructions guide Rootly Agents on how to carry out tasks and respond to requests
